title: Allowing Singles or Estranged Persons to Live Alone Instead of Requiring Co-tenants for HDB Rental Flats
what_it_is: Allowing Singles or Estranged Persons to Live Alone Instead of Requiring Co-tenants for HDB Rental Flats

sections.label: Joint Singles Scheme improvements
sections.summary: HDB allows flexibility for JSS applicants with exceptional circumstances, installs partitions, and pilots an Operator-Run model with 400 bedspaces at three sites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For JSS applicants with exceptional circumstances, such as medical grounds, HDB has exercised flexibility to allow them to rent a flat alone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: While many applicants and tenants are able to find a flatmate and live amicably under the JSS, some face difficulties applying for or sharing a flat, and we have, therefore, been reviewing and improving the JSS in recent years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB has also been installing partitions in existing rental flats at tenants’ request.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: There are now a total of 1,230 partitioned flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB is also piloting the JSS Operator-Run model to allow singles to apply for a public rental flat individually, without having to find a flatmate first.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We, currently, have three sites, with a total of 400 bedspaces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The sites are managed by Social Service Agencies which oversee the flat-sharing arrangements, provide social support and mediate among tenants when needed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The pilot has been well-subscribed and HDB is assessing the pilot to see how it can be expanded.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We will continue to explore ways to improve the lived experiences of singles in public rental.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: We are looking into alternative typologies and will share more details soon.
